_note: Part A (detect) certificate types. Names match the Part B (tracking) app. id = the code handed to Part B. group = where Part B says it's kept. board = suggested for a COBO board by default (customers can change it). aka = other names it goes by (used in Gemini's instructions). looks = how to tell it apart at a glance.

types.name: Sales tax permit
types.looks: Issued by a state department of revenue / taxation / comptroller. Plain form-style certificate with an account or permit number.

types.name: Liquor license
types.looks: Issued by a state alcohol / ABC / liquor control board. Often mentions beer, wine, spirits, malt beverages or on-premises consumption.

types.name: Food service establishment permit
types.looks: Issued by a county or city health department. Text-heavy certificate with the establishment name, a permit number and dates. Not a big letter grade.

types.name: Health inspection grade card
types.looks: Dominated by one large letter grade (A, B, C) or numeric score, or a colored pass/conditional/closed placard, made to be read from across the room. Little body text.

types.name: City business license
types.looks: Issued by a city or county (finance, licensing or tax office). Lists business name, address, license number, often a fiscal year.

types.name: Certificate of occupancy
types.looks: Issued by a building / inspections department. Heading 'Certificate of Occupancy'; lists use group, construction type, sometimes occupant load. Full certificate, not a small placard.

types.name: Maximum occupancy placard
types.looks: Small sign or placard dominated by one big number of persons ('Occupancy not to exceed 120'), usually from the fire marshal. Little other text.

types.name: Fire operational permit
types.looks: Issued by a fire department / fire marshal / fire prevention bureau as a permit to operate. Not an extinguisher tag or a sprinkler report.

types.name: No-smoking signage
types.looks: A sign with the no-smoking symbol (crossed-out cigarette) and short text.

types.name: Federal labor law poster (FLSA, EEO, OSHA)
aka: Job Safety and Health: It's the Law
types.looks: Large poster (often laminated) packed with many boxed notices. US Department of Labor / EEOC / OSHA logos.

types.name: OSHA Form 300A injury summary
aka: Summary of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses
types.looks: A US government form titled 'Summary of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses', with number boxes and an OSHA header.

types.name: State labor law posters
types.looks: Large poster of boxed notices from a state department of labor / workforce agency (state name and seal).

types.name: State minimum wage notice
types.looks: A notice headed with the state's minimum wage and hourly rates. Often one box on an all-in-one state poster.

types.name: Workers' compensation coverage notice
types.looks: Names the workers' compensation insurance carrier and policy for employees. Often one box on an all-in-one state poster.

types.name: Handwashing signage at sinks
types.looks: Small sign with a handwashing picture and 'Employees must wash hands' style text.

types.name: Certified food protection manager certificate
types.looks: A person's certificate (their name in large type) from ServSafe / NRFSP / Prometric / a state, often with a seal. About letter size, not wallet size.

types.name: Food handler cards (all staff)
types.looks: Wallet or ID-card size cards (or small certificates), one per employee, often several together.

types.name: Hood suppression system service tag
types.looks: Small hang tag with punched month/year boxes, from a fire protection company. Normally hangs on the kitchen hood.

types.name: Fire extinguisher annual inspection
types.looks: Small punched tag (usually on the extinguisher) or a service company's inspection report listing extinguishers.

types.name: Pest control service report
types.looks: A service ticket / report on a pest control company's letterhead, with treatment details.

types.name: IRS employer identification letter
types.looks: A letter on Department of the Treasury / Internal Revenue Service letterhead assigning an EIN.

types.name: Exterior sign permit
types.looks: Permit from a city planning / zoning / building department for an outdoor sign.

types.name: Sprinkler system inspection report
types.looks: Multi-line inspection report or tag from a fire sprinkler company.

types.name: Grease trap / FOG permit
types.looks: Permit from a water / sewer / wastewater utility mentioning grease trap, interceptor or FOG.

types.name: Backflow prevention test certificate
types.looks: Test report form for a backflow prevention assembly (device serial, test results) from a certified tester or water utility.

types.name: Certificate of insurance
types.looks: Usually the ACORD 25 'Certificate of Liability Insurance' form: dense grid of policies and limits.

types.name: Alarm system permit
types.looks: Permit or registration from a police department or city for a security / burglar alarm.
